newsitem.title: BELGIUM: PetroFina seeks full control of Fina unit.
newsitem.headline: PetroFina seeks full control of Fina unit.

text.p: Belgian oil and energy group PetroFina said on Tuesday it was looking to take full control of its U.S. subsidiary Fina Inc by offering Fina shareholders $60 per share.
The total value of the transaction was estimated at $266 million, PetroFina said in a statement.
PetroFina also said that it intended to seek a listing of its shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
The decisions were taken by a special meeting of the board of directors held on Tuesday, PetroFina said.
The bid aims to raise the stake held by PetroFina and its affiliates in Fina to 100 percent from the current 85.4 percent.
Whether Fina shareholders would get PetroFina shares, cash, or an option of either was still the subject of negotiations with independent directors of Fina.
PetroFina said it would seek to buy back any PetroFina shares issued as a result of the proposed takeover to avoid increasing the total number of shares outstanding.
An NYSE listing would make PetroFina the Belgian company listed there and give it improved access to U.S. capital markets.
